Team —

We need a tight interlock for the NimbusSoft launch next month. TL;DR: product has three outstanding asks that affect timing; infra needs clarity on an SLA exception path; enablement/docs need a slim handoff for partner-facing materials.

What I want from this thread (by EOD Tue 5/18):
- Product (Lauren): confirm final feature set for v1 (toggle-able on/off) so we can lock infra sizing.
- Infra/Runtime (Vivek): confirm whether we can meet the 100ms P95 target for the short prompt path; if not, outline exception approval steps.
- Enablement (Marissa/Tessa): agree owner for the partner-facing runbook and a minimal set of training slides.

Notes/context: Nimbus will be doing a phased rollout: 10% initial traffic for 2 weeks, then 50% after smoke tests. They want regional routing in us-east only for week 1. Nimbus procurement is ok with a short SLA carve (they expect 99.5% but asked if we can target 99.9%).

Attachments: enablement_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet) — initial proposed dates and owners.

Proposed immediate plan:
- Today: Product confirms v1 feature list.
- This week: Infra runs a focused perf test on short prompt path and reports numbers.
- By Fri 5/21: Marissa/Tessa hand over partner runbook draft to Olivia (Nimbus) for review.

If anyone needs to escalate to leadership for an SLA exception or budget for dedicated bursts, call it out here and I’ll route the ask.

Thanks —
Ben

Thanks Ben — quick answers and a few product clarifications.

1) v1 feature set (what we will ship):
   - Core generation endpoint (templated prompts, no tools) — ON
   - Streaming: ON (but with a 1s client-side buffer recommendation)
   - Function-calls / tool calling: OFF for v1 (we will schedule for v1.1)
   - Per-tenant KV-cache: ON (note: kv cache size will be capped to 64MB for initial launch)

2) Two product asks that affect infra sizing and rollout:
   - Toggle for per-tenant cache bypass (we need a way to bypass cache for Nimbus for debugging). Impact: small memory variant but adds route-level config.
   - Prefer regional sticky routing for certain customers (we need a rollout flag to pin sessions to us-east during week 1).

Questions for infra: does the cache bypass option materially increase tail latency? If so, we should consider a temporary quota or opt-in for Nimbus.

Owner notes: I can confirm the feature set by EOD 5/18 but need a brief call (15m) with Vivek to agree on the cache bypass semantics. Vivek — are you available 11:00–11:30?

On enablement: I will draft 3 sample prompts + expected behaviors and post to the drive folder today.

—Lauren

Thanks for the clarity — this helps. Short answers from infra:
- Baseline perf: for the short prompt path (avg token length < 40) our P95 on the current staging build sits ~120–150ms on p4d-16. We can likely hit ~100–110ms with an extra kernel patch and reduced batch sizes, but that introduces a higher cost-per-token and slightly lower throughput.
- Cache bypass: bypassing KV cache for a tenant increases tail variance; 95th moves +30–40ms in our tests. The bypass itself is doable as a route-level flag.

SLA exception ask: to guarantee 100ms P95 we'd need a dedicated burst pool for Nimbus for the first two weeks or an exemption to the global autoscaler which would cost roughly $X/day (I put numbers in the attached form). If leadership approves a temporary exception, operations can stand up a reserved pool and we can hit the 100ms bar.

Attachment: exception_request_form.pdf (pdf) — quick cost and ops impact note.

Availability: I can join the 11:00 slot for a quick sync with Lauren, otherwise propose 11:30.

—Vivek
